description: At a 390px mobile viewport the header nav has no responsive treatment: the logo 'Harness Arena' wraps to 2 lines and the 'How it works' link wraps to 3 lines. geometry-audit.js also flags the nav container overflowing its box by 15px (overflow-x: visible).
expected: Nav collapses to a hamburger/menu pattern, or links abbreviate/stack cleanly, below a reasonable breakpoint (matches Visual Correctness / Layout Quality rubric: 'elements reflow gracefully').
actual: Five nav items (logo + 4 links) are forced into one row at 390px, causing 2 of them to wrap mid-phrase ('How' / 'it' / 'works' on 3 separate lines).
suggested_fix: Add a mobile breakpoint that switches the header nav to a hamburger/drawer, or reduce to icon-only / stacked links under ~480px.

description: Progress is shown via two separate counters that always move in lockstep for this 10-clip/5-comparison fixture: the batch-relative heading ('Comparison 2 of 5') and the lifetime counter ('1 of 5 judged'). A first-time user has no way to tell these are two different concepts (position-in-batch vs. total-judged) rather than a restated duplicate, since with this fixture N-1 always equals the judged count.
expected: Either a single counter, or a visual/textual cue that these represent different things (matters once real sessions span multiple batches of 10).
actual: Two numeric progress indicators presented with no distinguishing framing beyond position (top-left vs. top-right) and different phrasing.
suggested_fix: Low priority given fixture size; worth revisiting once real sessions have >1 batch and the two numbers diverge meaningfully.
